items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Nancy wanted to step in there, but Nancy wasn‘t strong enough to step in there with Dinah.

ctx.x: I know the name very well, but I don‘t know exactly why. I know he‘s an agent.
That‘s right. At that time, John Levy had, oh, good lord, he had all the top acts. He had Wes Montgomery. Well, he‘s had Nancy Wilson and Joe Williams for fifty years.
